_about: No ammo crates on the maps Free for All is played on (the owner, 2026-11-12/13: "there should just be no ammo crates", "then noone can resupply"): every ammo crate of each project a Free for All config names (Team Deathmatch's own, so Team Deathmatch on those maps too), removed whole: its resupply_zone(s), decal(s) and collision_geometry (client_objects), its container_closed model(s) (render_visuals) and their collision_objects. Crates a project: level_01/day_4 2, level_01/evening_4 2, level_01/rain_4 2, level_02/day_4 2, level_02/evening_4 2, level_02/rain_4 2, level_03/day_4 2, level_03/evening_4 2, level_03/rain_4 2, level_04/day_4 2, level_04/evening_4 2, level_04/rain_4 2, level_05/day_4 2, level_05/evening_4 2, level_05/rain_4 2, level_06/day_4 2, level_06/evening_4 2, level_06/rain_4 2, level_07/day_4 2, level_07/evening_4 2, level_07/rain_4 2, level_08/day_4 2, level_08/evening_4 2, level_08/prerain_4 2, level_09/day_4 2, v010b_cs_mp_bath/day_4 2, v010b_cs_mp_military_1/day_4 8, v010b_cs_training_camp/day_4 6, v011e_level_03/day_4 2, v011e_level_04/day_4 2, v021d_level_03/day_4 2, v021d_level_06/day_4 2, v069d_level_01/day_4 2. Generated by scripts/ffa-mode/make_no_crates_edits.py from the projects as every row above leaves them; `_inputs` brings the configs it reads. Changes the simulation (simulation_changes.tsv).
